title: Fukushima
synopsis: At the Fukushima Daiichi nuclear power plant, a veteran engineer believes the facility can withstand a devastating natural disaster. As the catastrophe unfolds, his confidence gives way to an escalating fight against forces beyond human control.

audienceReactions.quote: It feels like a seamless continuous shot, which is absolutely stunning.
audienceReactions.author: @motoCF-h2p

audienceReactions.quote: Oh man, this is SO damn good. Seriously, one of the best short films I've had the pleasure of watching so far! The whole idea of doing it without a single cut is brilliant.
